description: UCB has announced a Request for Proposals (RFP) for independent medical education initiatives. This funding opportunity seeks to support high-quality educational programs that address critical gaps in the recognition, assessment, and management of acute seizure events and seizure emergencies among people living with epilepsy.

Rigel Pharmaceuticals has an Independent Medical Education (IME) Grant Request for Proposal focused on the evolving treatment landscape and disease management for patients with ER-positive/HER-negative metastatic breast cancer.
